diagnosis.H3: The scalar isolation-to-service decline is capable of reproducing the empirical positive pollen-limitation isolation slope; the best candidate is within 0.28 empirical SE.
diagnosis.H1_H2_generalization: Adding floral generalization breadth is not sufficient to make generalization increase with isolation across all four contexts. The best candidates commonly produce negative generalization slopes in northern high-latitude and tropical contexts.
diagnosis.H4_assurance: The simulated assurance-to-pollen-limitation coefficient has the wrong sign in every top candidate. In v1, assurance is predominantly an environmentally induced response and the emulator lacks within-isolation lineage/species variation matching the empirical H4 estimand.
diagnosis.H4_generalization: The sign can be negative as observed, but the magnitude is often much stronger than the empirical coefficient.
diagnosis.structural_inference: The failure pattern points to missing biological structure rather than only sparse parameter search: isolation-dependent visitor assembly/replacement and within-island lineage heterogeneity are required before a larger search is justified.

claim_boundary: Zero of 64 passing draws is a prospective negative result and is not rescued by widening the same v1 search.
Model3R-v1 is not evidence that the Chapter 1 island syndrome has been realistically reproduced.
The display holdout was not used for fitting or failure diagnosis.
H3 reproduction alone is insufficient because H1/H2 functional recurrence and H4 functional associations must be reproduced jointly.
